evidence.scope: Finite normalized presentations, positive-evidence observations, and the supported tier Q_R absolutely continuous with respect to the retained posterior for sharp equality and uniqueness.
side_conditions: Counting measures and full finite sigma-algebras.
Recognition is chosen after the generative law and observation.
Extended-real equality is not used to infer a conditional equality on posterior-null retained states.

evidence.scope: Strictly positive C2 finite categorical retained families and the explicit binary marginal-lift family on the open unit square.
side_conditions: Presentation equality is parameterwise, not merely pointwise at one parameter.
Sample relabelings are fixed and parameter independent.
The joint lift is declared model structure.

evidence.scope: The explicit direct, latent-chain, and independent-null-node XOR presentations on binary finite spaces.
side_conditions: Parameters a, b, and eta lie in the open unit interval.
All presentations use the same parameter identification and retained conditioning algebra.

evidence.scope: Exact rational and high-precision numerical corroboration for one binary dilation and the central categorical-lift Fisher matrices.
side_conditions: This executable corroborates but does not prove the universal mathematical claims.
CPU-only deterministic Python with no random inputs.

claims.statement: For finite normalized agent/environment presentations, characterize observational presentation equivalence and prove exactly which variational-free-energy and Fisher-geometric objects descend: (i) the collapsed VFE on retained variables is invariant under every environment-node dilation preserving the retained joint law and conditioning sigma-algebra; (ii) the full-latent VFE differs from the collapsed VFE by an explicit conditional-KL defect and agrees only after conditional-posterior completion or conditional minimization; (iii) a regular retained-joint Fisher pullback descends under parameterwise retained-law equivalence; and (iv) paired marginal agent sections alone do not determine a full-joint VFE or joint Fisher geometry, as witnessed by explicit smooth finite categorical lifts with identical marginals.
claims.quantifiers: For every pair of finite presentations with common nonempty retained latent space R and record space O that induce the same normalized retained joint law P_RO and the same retained conditioning sigma-algebra, and for every regular observation o and admissible retained recognition law Q_R, conclusions (i) and (ii) hold. For every C2 strictly positive finite categorical family whose presentations induce the same P_RO,theta for every parameter theta, conclusion (iii) holds. There exist explicit binary presentations and smooth lifts satisfying conclusion (iv). Pointwise fixed-observation equalities are asserted only for declared density representatives; otherwise they hold for P_O-almost every o.
claims.falsifier: A normalized finite counterexample satisfying the frozen hypotheses refutes a universal descent or defect conjunct; failure of the explicit binary smooth lifts refutes the existential noncanonicity conjunct.

claims.statement: The collapsed VFE is constant on every observational-equivalence class of finite presentations.
claims.quantifiers: For every equivalent finite pair, every positive-evidence retained observation, and every admissible common retained recognition law.
claims.falsifier: Two equivalent presentations with different retained evidence, posterior, or collapsed VFE refute the claim.

claims.statement: A full-latent VFE equals the collapsed VFE plus the retained expectation of an auxiliary conditional KL; on the supported finite tier equality and conditional minimization occur exactly at posterior completion.
claims.quantifiers: For every finite presentation, positive-evidence observation, and admissible disintegrated recognition law; the iff and unique-joint-minimizer statements require Q_R to be absolutely continuous with respect to the retained posterior.
claims.falsifier: A supported finite chain-rule failure, a nonposterior zero conditional KL, or a lower conditional lift refutes the claim.

claims.statement: An arbitrary uncompleted full-latent VFE does not descend under observational equivalence.
claims.quantifiers: There exists a finite observationally null auxiliary split and an admissible recognition kernel producing a strict positive defect.
claims.falsifier: If every auxiliary recognition kernel in the explicit null-node construction has zero defect, the witness fails.

claims.statement: The Fisher tensor of a regular retained joint family descends under parameterwise retained-law equivalence and fixed sample relabeling.
claims.quantifiers: For every C2 strictly positive finite categorical family with equality for all parameters under a common parameter identification, and every common pullback map.
claims.falsifier: Two parameterwise equal positive finite families with unequal score covariances refute the claim.

claims.statement: The direct, latent-chain, and null-node binary XOR presentations have identical retained laws and retained Fisher tensors but different full Fisher tensors.
claims.quantifiers: For every a, b, and eta in (0,1) under the explicit construction.
claims.falsifier: Failure of the XOR convolution identity or any displayed score-covariance calculation rejects the construction.

claims.statement: Paired binary marginals alone do not determine either a full-joint VFE or a full-joint Fisher pullback.
claims.quantifiers: There exist two smooth positive right-inverse lifts on the open binary marginal square with the same extracted marginals but different VFE values and Fisher tensors.
claims.falsifier: Failure of the right-inverse construction or equality of both induced VFE and Fisher objects refutes the existential witness.

claims.statement: The product lift and the declared correlated perturbation are distinct smooth positive right inverses of paired binary marginalization.
claims.quantifiers: For every (a,b) in the open unit square and kappa equal to zero or one half.
claims.falsifier: A negative component, failed normalization, or wrong extracted marginal rejects a lift.

claims.statement: The two explicit lifts assign different full-joint VFE values at the same paired marginal configuration.
claims.quantifiers: At a=b=1/2 for the declared trivial-observation posterior choices.
claims.falsifier: A zero exact KL gap for the displayed laws rejects the claim.

claims.statement: The two explicit lifts induce distinct full-joint Fisher pullbacks at the same paired marginal configuration.
claims.quantifiers: At a=b=1/2 for the declared smooth lift families.
claims.falsifier: Equality of the two displayed pullback matrices rejects the claim.

claims.statement: The retained observational quotient cannot recover every presentation's original typed auxiliary intervention structure.
claims.quantifiers: For the explicit direct and latent binary presentations when b is not one half, under kernel-replacement intervention semantics.
claims.falsifier: An isomorphism between the singleton direct auxiliary intervention and the two outcome-distinguishing E interventions rejects this witness.

claims.statement: A canonical autonomous-agent presentation can be selected uniquely up to an independently declared isomorphism from observational-equivalence data alone.
claims.quantifiers: Across all admissible finite presentations under an as-yet undeclared naturality or universality criterion.
claims.falsifier: Two presentations satisfying the eventual full canonicalization premises but lacking a unique natural representative would refute a proposed theorem.

claims.statement: The finite descended informational objects determine a continuum physical geometry, causal structure, time, or dimensional constants.
claims.quantifiers: For a future continuum limit and operational bridge not specified in this contract.
claims.falsifier: A future bridge must supply its own typed premises and discriminating evidence; no such bridge is included here.
